tour.welcomeContent: This sidebar is where you submit and track your reports.
tour.submitContent: File a new report tied to your account for easier tracking and follow-up.
tour.statsContent: A quick summary of how many reports you have submitted, and where they stand.
tour.reportsContent: All your reports live here — switch between grid and list view, or filter by status.
tour.activityContent: See the latest updates on your reports as soon as they happen.
tour.anonymousContent: Prefer not to attach your identity? You can still file a report anonymously.
tour.securityContent: All reports and messages are end-to-end encrypted for your safety.
tour.accountContent: Manage your profile or log out from here.
tour.myReportsNavContent: Every report you have submitted lives here, with its status and history.
tour.newReportContent: File a new report tied to your account at any time.
tour.filtersContent: Search by ID, or narrow the list by status, priority, and sort order.
tour.viewsContent: Toggle between a compact table and a card grid, whichever you prefer.
tour.resultsContent: Click any report to view its full details and message the compliance team.
